Correction: The student asked "May I take CS4353 in Y3 Sem 2?".
CS4353 is offered in "Sem 1".
Y3 Sem 2 corresponds to Semester 6 (even).
Therefore, CS4353 is not offered in that semester.

Let's double check the definition of "Sem 1" and "Sem 2".
"Odd semesters are Semester 1 of the academic year, even semesters are Semester 2."
Y3S1 = 5 (Odd -> Sem 1)
Y3S2 = 6 (Even -> Sem 2)
CS4353 is offered in "Sem 1". This means it can be taken in Semester 5, 7, etc.
It is NOT offered in Semester 6.

So the answer is NOT_ELIGIBLE because of the semester offering.

Let's verify prerequisites again just in case.
CS4353 Prereq: ((CS2103DE or CS2103 or CS2103T or CS2113) and CS3240) or ...
Student has CS2103T (completed).
Student has CS3240 (completed).
So prereqs are met.
But offering is Sem 1 only.
Y3 Sem 2 is Sem 2 of the year.
So not eligible.
